title: Emotion Analysis in NLP: Trends, Gaps and Roadmap for Future Directions

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying 154 NLP publications to evaluate whether the demographics (such as age, gender, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status) of annotators and data creators are reported and integrated into emotion analysis dataset creation and modeling.

Evaluating the literature's prevalent reliance on universal discrete emotion frameworks (like Ekman's model), which assume emotions are experienced universally in the same manner and fail to account for cultural variations in emotion perception.
Analyzing the linguistic diversity of existing emotion analysis datasets in the reviewed literature and highlighting the overwhelming dominance of English-language resources.
